insight: The Prague-built Integromat, acquired by Celonis for $100M+ in 2020 and rebranded to Make in Feb 2022.
name: Make
tagline: Visual-canvas automation. The Integromat folks went big on AI nodes.
description: Drag-and-drop scenario builder with first-class AI provider nodes. More expressive than Zapier for complex routing and conditional logic; favoured when your automation has branches and loops.
edge: Visual-canvas builder that handles branching, loops, and conditional routing Zapier's linear steps struggle with.
cons: Complex scenarios get hard to debug

references.title: n8n vs Make vs Zapier: Which automation tool should you choose?
